title: [3.0 RC1] VersionChecker - logs on the first day that the new RC1 version is expired
symptom: After installing 3.0 RC1, on the same day a notification appears stating that a new version has been available for at least 1 day and that the version will expire, even though 3.0 RC1 is the newest version. Logs show 'Version 3.0-rc1 expired.' and a message about expiration on 31.01.22.
cause: The behavior is correct: RC versions really expire. The message is confusing because it suggests a newer version exists, but the version checker correctly detects that the RC is expired.
evidence_quote: it looks like this behavior is correct. RC really expires
